requirement_summary: Coordinate the operational execution of private sales across the sale cycle.
Resolve client enquiries and issues while executing client transactions.
Maintain required legal and compliance documentation, including consignment and transaction records.
Coordinate authentication, third-party reviews, photography, shipping, inventory and post-sale activity.
One to three years of business administration, operations and/or client-service experience.
Proficiency with MS Word, Outlook, Excel and general familiarity with database management.
Fluency in English, Cantonese and Mandarin, including reading and writing Traditional Chinese.
Deep knowledge of the international jewellery market, including gemstones, signed jewels and important collections.
Prepare valuations, consignment proposals and strategic presentations for major collections.
Maintain an established network of collectors, dealers, family offices, advisers and institutions.
Five or more years in a specialist role at an international auction house or recognised jewellery business.
GIA, FGA or an equivalent professional qualification.
Fluency in English and French; additional European languages are desirable.
Source property, generate new business and lead a European sourcing strategy.
Lead and mentor a small team while delivering commercial results.
Communicate, present and negotiate confidently with sophisticated international clients.
